uses.title: 1204 · Last person to fit in the bus
uses.snippet:
WITH cumulative AS (
    SELECT person_name, turn, SUM(weight) OVER (ORDER BY turn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_weight
    FROM Queue
)

uses.title: 1321 · Restaurant growth
uses.snippet:
SELECT visited_on,
           SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 6 DAY PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount,
           MIN(visited_on) OVER () AS first_day
    FROM daily
